data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross reserve strengthening of GBP 69.329 million for prior underwriting years, representing 21.43% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening was driven by higher loss experience and required reserve strengthening on UK Professional Indemnity and International Liability accounts for 2022 and prior years. The overall prior year development was mixed, with adverse development in certain financial lines classes partially offset by positive developments in other classes. Contributing factors included the risk of higher-than-expected inflation, developments in large losses and catastrophes, changes in attritional losses, and movements in the Ogden rate. A reinsurance transaction on prior year claims liabilities also had a positive impact on the reported profit.
